name: Grand Cross
summary:
Grand Cross (グランドクロス) is a pinball game developed by Excellent System. The game contains 11 different items and 5 stages, as well as a bonus stage.

The setting of the game depicts the battle between the Douglas Empire and Earth, and the pinball in-universe is Earth's mightiest weapon, Dynam. The player starts with 10 lives, which can either by lost by Dynam's life bar running out or from losing it at the bottom of the board.
